risk_note: RV2-level sensitive data (identity realname). POST /v1/me/realname: 10005 (guard ⑧) → 10004 id_verification consent (latest user-level row, no version check) → already verified answers 200 with the masked name (E26) → 20001 (name / 18-digit id and check digit) → 30407 under 14 → 30410 daily limit → 30405 id already verified by someone else → provider (match verified / mismatch 30406 with a failed row, E27). Daily 3 attempts in Redis, deduplicated per request (key + keyed digest of the normalised name and id); the provider's definite outcome is kept on the marker and reused by a same-key retry without calling the provider; a pending marker answers 50401 without giving the attempt back (orchestrator ruling A) and turns terminal after a 30 s lease; markers are not keyed by date (48 h TTL), so a retry across +08:00 midnight cannot bypass them; invariant: provider calls with a definite outcome ≤ the day's count ≤ 3. Name, id and birth date are FieldCrypto columns with a blind index; 23505 → 30405; names and ids never reach logs or responses. The fake verifier is injected only in local / test (staging / prod 50301, E9). Guard ⑨ and GET /v1/me read the table; submitRealname leaves planned. Follow-up recorded: the platform idempotency request hash is an unkeyed sha256 of the body (raised to the orchestrator). Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
